evidence.title: Here's what would change in LA if you vote ‘yes’ for these measures

occurrences.checkable_against: Los Angeles Charter Amendment LA ballot text
occurrences.quote_span: Make Los Angeles adopt a two-year budget (the city currently adopts a budget each year)
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Los Angeles 2026 local ballot measures

occurrences.checkable_against: Los Angeles Charter Amendment LA ballot text
occurrences.quote_span: Require the city to adopt a capital infrastructure plan
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Los Angeles 2026 local ballot measures

occurrences.checkable_against: Los Angeles Ordinance FD ballot text
occurrences.quote_span: A citizen oversight committee will monitor expenditures.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Los Angeles 2026 local ballot measures

occurrences.checkable_against: Los Angeles Charter Amendment PRT ballot text
occurrences.quote_span: It also requires the Harbor Department to allocate funds for waterfront public access projects and other programs.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Los Angeles 2026 local ballot measures

occurrences.checkable_against: Los Angeles Charter Amendment LA ballot text
occurrences.quote_span: Require the city to adopt a capital infrastructure plan
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Los Angeles 2026 local ballot measures

occurrences.checkable_against: Los Angeles Amendment PRK campaign materials and ballot analysis
occurrences.quote_span: Supporters of this amendment say it’ll clean and improve parks, restrooms, pools, and facilities; rebuild the parks and ranger workforce; and keep pools, recreation centers, and senior centers open.
occurrences.speaker: supporters of Amendment PRK
occurrences.subject: Los Angeles 2026 local ballot measures

occurrences.checkable_against: Los Angeles Amendment PRK ballot text and fiscal analysis
occurrences.quote_span: If passed, the amendment would increase the minimum amount of General Fund money allocated to the Department of Recreation and Parks, phased in over 10 years.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Los Angeles 2026 local ballot measures

occurrences.checkable_against: Los Angeles Ordinance FD ballot text and city fiscal analysis
occurrences.quote_span: generating roughly $345 million annually for the Los Angeles Fire Department.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Los Angeles 2026 local ballot measures

occurrences.checkable_against: Los Angeles Charter Amendment PL ballot text
occurrences.quote_span: The amendment will establish clearer procedures regarding when the Los Angeles City Council reviews commissions’ decisions, supporters said, among other changes.
occurrences.speaker: supporters of Charter Amendment PL
occurrences.subject: Los Angeles 2026 local ballot measures

occurrences.checkable_against: Los Angeles Charter Amendment EE ballot text
occurrences.quote_span: It’d also increase the maximum monetary penalty for campaign finance violations; strengthen the independence of the Police Department Inspector General and the Fire Department Independent Assessor to open and conduct investigations or audits; and require the city council to meet at least weekly, rather than three days a week or more.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Los Angeles 2026 local ballot measures

occurrences.checkable_against: Los Angeles Charter Amendment LA ballot text
occurrences.quote_span: Removes restrictions that banned Los Angeles from mortgaging city-owned property and prevented Los Angeles from operating purely commercial or industrial businesses
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Los Angeles 2026 local ballot measures

occurrences.checkable_against: Los Angeles Charter Amendment PRT ballot text
occurrences.quote_span: If passed, this charter amendment would require that three of the seven members of the Board of Airport Commissioners reside near LAX, and two of the seven members reside near Van Nuys Airport.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Los Angeles 2026 local ballot measures

occurrences.checkable_against: Los Angeles Ordinance FD ballot text and city fiscal analysis
occurrences.quote_span: A “yes” vote would increase Los Angeles’ sales tax from 10.25% to 10.75%, generating roughly $345 million annually for the Los Angeles Fire Department.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Los Angeles 2026 local ballot measures

occurrences.checkable_against: Los Angeles Ordinance FD ballot text and city fiscal analysis
occurrences.quote_span: A “yes” vote would increase Los Angeles’ sales tax from 10.25% to 10.75%
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Los Angeles 2026 local ballot measures

occurrences.checkable_against: Los Angeles Amendment PRK ballot text and fiscal analysis
occurrences.quote_span: This amendment doesn’t create new revenue; Instead, Los Angeles would have to reallocate General Fund revenue from other areas.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Los Angeles 2026 local ballot measures

occurrences.checkable_against: Los Angeles Proposition TE ballot text
occurrences.quote_span: If passed, this exemption would be in effect until Jan. 6, 2030.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Los Angeles 2026 local ballot measures

occurrences.checkable_against: Los Angeles real-property transfer-tax ordinance and Proposition ULA records
occurrences.quote_span: A proposition passed by voters several years ago imposed a 4% tax on the sale or transfer of real property over $5 million and a 5.5% tax on sales or transfers at $10 million or more.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Los Angeles 2026 local ballot measures

occurrences.checkable_against: Los Angeles Charter Amendment EE ballot text
occurrences.quote_span: Voting “yes” for Amendment EE would ban the executive director and commissioners of the Ethics Commission from running for city offices, or the Los Angeles Unified Board of Education office, for five years after leaving their position.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Los Angeles 2026 local ballot measures

occurrences.checkable_against: Los Angeles Charter Amendment LA campaign materials and ballot analysis
occurrences.quote_span: Supporters say the amendment helps Los Angeles plan infrastructure long term and account for future costs by moving the budget to a two-year cycle.
occurrences.speaker: supporters of Charter Amendment LA
occurrences.subject: Los Angeles 2026 local ballot measures

occurrences.checkable_against: Los Angeles Charter Amendment PL ballot text
occurrences.quote_span: One major change under this amendment is replacing the Area Planning Commissions — the seven commissions that represent swaths of the city and hear small-scale projects and appeals — with a Neighborhood Appeals Board, with supporters saying it’ll create a “more consistent citywide process for hearing planning appeals.”
occurrences.speaker: supporters of Charter Amendment PL
occurrences.subject: Los Angeles 2026 local ballot measures

occurrences.checkable_against: Monica Rodriguez statement opposing Los Angeles Charter Amendment LA
occurrences.quote_span: However, Los Angeles City Councilmember Monica Rodriguez described the amendment as giving the city “the authority to eliminate the Board of Public Works and consolidate its powers under a single individual” and removing an “important check and balance” in her argument against it.
occurrences.speaker: Los Angeles City Councilmember Monica Rodriguez
occurrences.subject: Los Angeles 2026 local ballot measures

occurrences.checkable_against: Los Angeles Proposition ULA expenditure records
occurrences.quote_span: This revenue goes toward affordable housing and tenant assistance programs.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Los Angeles 2026 local ballot measures

occurrences.checkable_against: Los Angeles Ordinance FD ballot text and fiscal analysis
occurrences.quote_span: More specifically, it would fund hiring and retaining firefighters and paramedics and purchasing and maintaining equipment like fire trucks, ambulances, and emergency communications systems — among other “LAFD-specific purposes.”
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Los Angeles 2026 local ballot measures

occurrences.checkable_against: Los Angeles Proposition TE fiscal analysis
occurrences.quote_span: It’s estimated this could reduce revenue by $35 million to $66 million through January 2030.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Los Angeles 2026 local ballot measures
